title: Consolidated Prefix Registry for Cross-Request KV Sharing and GPU Residency
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description: Background: Multiple recent incidents and bench runs show that identical prompt prefixes and system tokens are frequently materialized independently in per-request KV stores, leading to duplicated GPU-resident KV memory and reduced effective batching. Goal: Design and implement a consolidated prefix registry (CPR) that allows safe cross-request prefix reuse, compact on-GPU residency, and reference-counted deduplication without regressing tail latency or violating tenant isolation guarantees. Scope: model-serving runtime (inference engine), prefix catalog format, memory residency manager, cache admission/eviction policy, and necessary console/telemetry hooks.
acceptance_criteria: CPR exposes a stable fingerprint and compact serialized representation (PackedPrefix v1) that reduces median per-prefix GPU memory footprint by >=40% for tested Llama-derivatives
Cross-request reuse achieved: duplicate prefix materializations reduced by >=60% on mixed PLG traffic trace (internal benchmark)
No measurable regression in 99th-percentile token latency (<=2ms from baseline) under standard batching load
Eviction semantics: reference-counted prefixes may be evicted only when count==0; eviction triggers free GPU memory and metrics emitted
Runtime config flags to opt-in per-customer and per-model namespace; telemetry surfaced in Console with breakdown by model, prefix-hit-rate, and memory savings

notes: Implementation outline: 1) Prefix fingerprinting + namespace; 2) PackedPrefix serializer that compacts KV tensors into contiguous GPU buffers; 3) Sharded in-memory registry with CAS inserts; 4) Refcounting with batched delta flush to persistent memtable; 5) Eviction policy combining LRU-ish recency + dynamic memory pressure
Trade-offs: strong dedup reduces memory but increases metadata overhead. We prioritize GPU memcpy locality and bulk frees to keep allocator behavior friendly
Security: Tenant namespaces prevent cross-tenant reuse. PackedPrefix storage will be encrypted at rest in Private deployments; runtime in-host memory stays plain but isolated per-process
Telemetry: new metrics prefix.registry.hits, prefix.registry.inserts, prefix.registry.evictions, prefix.memory.saved_bytes; add tracing spans around materialize/attach operations
Rollout plan: feature-flagged per-cluster, start with internal beta, then 10% of hosted traffic, then ramp after 2 weeks with no regression
